name: Igra na vyzhivaniye
source:
It seemed that nothing foreshadowed trouble. Semyon had already started getting used to this world of the 80s when suddenly events began to take a rather dangerous turn. Will he be able to uncover the killer's identity? Or will he become the next victim? Everything depends on you.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1765764834]Steam[/url]]
